title: Count the skills and groups in this repo and write a health report
brief: Count how many skill folders exist under skills/ (a skill is a folder holding SKILL.md, found at skills/<group>/<skill>) and how many groups there are. Write a short markdown report to docs/log/harness/repo-health.md with the exact total number of skills and the number of groups. Use read-only commands to count; do not guess.

verify.name: report-has-the-true-skill-count
cmd: import pathlib,re,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tools/skillkit'); import skill_paths; n=len(list(skill_paths.iter_skills('skills'))); t=pathlib.Path('docs/log/harness/repo-health.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'(?<!\d)%d(?!\d)' % n, t) else 1)
